confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on mostly 2025-2026 aggregated cost-of-living figures (Numbeo, Expatistan, HikersBay, Livingcost, MyLifeElsewhere, Gotripzi); some inputs are older or undated. Beer assumes about a half-litre domestic serving. Cocktail and wine are weaker: no aggregated Colombo bar or wine-by-the-glass average was found, so they lean on upscale hotel and club menus discounted toward typical venues and cross-checked against the beer anchor. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation search, live listing or booking page was checked. The FX reading (18 Nov 2026, latest found) comes from search-result summaries citing the RBA overview page; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is South Asia. Food and drink anchors are Colombo-specific and not transferred from another city. Accommodation tiers reflect general knowledge of South Asian tourist-capital guesthouse and hotel pricing, with no named comparison city.
